external_ask: 请检索并确认是否存在已完成的 Phase III randomized controlled trials evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) or defined microbial consortia combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumors, and report their primary endpoint results.
question: 是否存在已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验证实微生物组干预在 ICI 治疗患者中的疗效？
read_focus: 重点检索 TACITO 试验后续是否进行了 III 期扩展，以及是否有其他独立的 Phase III FMT-ICI 联合疗法 RCT 完成并发表结果。

usable_content: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。 This study reports results from a Phase II trial (FMT-LUMINate, NCT04951583) involving 20 previously untreated patients with advanced melanoma receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and nivolumab). The design was single-arm with safety as the primary endpoint. The authors observed an objective response rate (ORR) of 70% (2 complete responses, 12 partial responses), but also noted high rates of immune-related adverse events (65% grade >3, including 20% diarrhea/colitis and 2 cases of myocarditis). The conclusion states that these results support the study of FMT and immunotherapy in the randomized setting, indicating that definitive randomized evidence is not yet established by this work.
